notes:
New Features:

+ Adds Guljaj.com as a hybrid Site: the public Adults (18+) catalog supplies 24 pages, channel names and artwork while logged-in live.guljaj.com resolves the full stream.

+ Adds a dedicated Guljaj Status tab with a Check button at the top, All Pages mode, and independent multi-selection for pages 1-24.

+ Guljaj credentials are requested in Kodi and stored only in the local Adult TV Test state; no login data is embedded in the Site package.

Bugfixes:

- Guljaj status checks use the v1.108 player-free bounded HLS/segment probe and can try Player 1-4 without opening Kodi VideoPlayer.
